page.title: Your kitchen
page.purpose: Run setup and preferences: diet approach, exclusions with stated evidence limits, appliances, priorities, targets, and supplements, all as a draft until applied atomically.

priorities.statement: Setup edits are a labeled draft until the final atomic apply, and a resume restores the draft without activating it.
Allergen and exclusion evidence is stated as limited, and a missing tag is unknown rather than proof of absence.
The matching-meal count comes from the same eligibility service the planner uses, with no automatic relaxation to force a nonzero count.
Applying modified rules previews conflicts with existing plans, locks, and consumed history before any write.
Custom priority values remain distinct from presets and the planner's fixed dietary and kitchen rules are never overridden by a preference.

states.description: The surface at rest with data present; the state a journey step assumes when it names none.
First read of the page's data; layout is reserved so nothing shifts on arrival.
The read succeeded and there is genuinely nothing, which is distinct from not-yet-loaded.
Some contributing data could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown.
The request failed; the reason and the next available action are stated.
Input was rejected before submission; the offending field is identified next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control says why it is unavailable.
The client cannot reach the API; read-only or queued behavior is explained.
The review-and-apply step shows the summarized rules, the eligibility counts, and any plan conflicts before the atomic apply.
No stored meal satisfies the proposed rules; the page offers Add a meal or Adjust setup instead of weakening a restriction.
No appliances are selected; the product states that it will start with meals that can be assembled rather than assuming equipment.
The cost, effort, and variety sliders do not exactly match a preset, so the page reports Custom balance.
Recurring baseline slots and nutrition targets are being reviewed or edited as part of setup.

elements.name: Your food, Your kitchen, Your rhythm, Ready
elements.description: The four-step setup progress with a resumable draft.
States that edits are a draft and not active until applied.
Vegan, Vegetarian, Pescatarian, Everything, Plant-forward, and My own way.
Composable exclusion chips, each separate from the diet name.
The 'Anything else off the menu?' input that preserves the user's own wording.
States the evidence limit: a missing tag is unknown, not proof of absence.
The appliance picker, with zero appliances allowed.
A clickable, keyboard-operable appliance with a visible selected state.
Three ordinary-language questions for budget, weekday effort, and repeat meals.
A relative-importance control that reports Custom balance when it matches no preset.
Diet, exclusions, appliances, and priority bars summarized before apply.
The matching-meal count from the shared eligibility service, with fits, needs review, and excluded counts available.
Names an apply conflict with an existing plan, lock, or consumed record and what would resolve it.

elements.name: Apply
elements.description: The final atomic apply of profile and rules; staged plan effects remain explicit.

elements.name: Apply changes
elements.description: The conflict preview shown before the atomic apply.
Nutrient, unit, lower bound, upper bound, period, and required/preferred/informational setting.
Selects a supplement product, dose unit, label basis, and the user's schedule.
States that the product will start with meals that can be assembled when no appliance is selected.

claims.statement: Setup edits are labeled as a draft and are not active until the explicit atomic apply.
The page states that a missing allergen tag is unknown and that recognition from coarse tags is not certification.
With zero appliances selected the page states that it will start with assemble-only meals rather than assuming equipment.
Applying modified rules previews conflicts with existing plans, locks, and consumed history before any write.
The matching-meal count is produced by the same eligibility service the planner uses and is never inflated by relaxing a rule.
When nothing matches, the page says so and offers Add a meal or Adjust setup instead of weakening a restriction.
A custom priority vector is reported as Custom balance and is never shown as an exactly selected preset.
A nutrition target requires at least one bound and rejects a lower bound above its upper bound with the field identified.
Every appliance tile is keyboard operable and reports its selected state without relying on colour alone.
Setup and the review summary never scroll the whole document sideways at any supported viewport.
Recurring slots and nutrition targets are editable in setup and expressed separately from dated occurrences.
